ObjectStates.Name: Custom_Tile
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
-- Empty Collection - Generated by TTSMixmaster
-- Music Player for Tabletop Simulator

local MusicPlayer = {}

-- Playlist configuration
MusicPlayer.playlist = {
    
}

-- Player state
MusicPlayer.currentTrack = 1  -- Lua is 1-indexed
MusicPlayer.shuffle = false
MusicPlayer.repeat = false
MusicPlayer.isPlaying = false

-- Play current track
function MusicPlayer.play()
    if #MusicPlayer.playlist > 0 then
        local track = MusicPlayer.playlist[MusicPlayer.currentTrack]
        if track and track.url ~= "" then
            MusicPlayer.setPlaylist({track.url})
            MusicPlayer.play()
            MusicPlayer.isPlaying = true
            print("Now playing: " .. track.name)
        else
            print("No valid audio URL for current track")
        end
    else
        print("Playlist is empty")
    end
end

-- Stop playback
function MusicPlayer.stop()
    MusicPlayer.stop()
    MusicPlayer.isPlaying = false
    print("Music stopped")
end

-- Next track
function MusicPlayer.next()
    if #MusicPlayer.playlist > 0 then
        if MusicPlayer.currentTrack < #MusicPlayer.playlist then
            MusicPlayer.currentTrack = MusicPlayer.currentTrack + 1
        elseif MusicPlayer.repeat then
            MusicPlayer.currentTrack = 1
        end
        MusicPlayer.play()
    end
end

-- Previous track
function MusicPlayer.previous()
    if #MusicPlayer.playlist > 0 then
        if MusicPlayer.currentTrack > 1 then
            MusicPlayer.currentTrack = MusicPlayer.currentTrack - 1
        elseif MusicPlayer.repeat then
            MusicPlayer.currentTrack = #MusicPlayer.playlist
        end
        MusicPlayer.play()
    end
end

-- Set track by index
function MusicPlayer.setTrack(index)
    if index >= 1 and index <= #MusicPlayer.playlist then
        MusicPlayer.currentTrack = index
        MusicPlayer.play()
    else
        print("Track index out of range: " .. index)
    end
end

-- Get current track info
function MusicPlayer.getCurrentTrack()
    if #MusicPlayer.playlist > 0 then
        local track = MusicPlayer.playlist[MusicPlayer.currentTrack]
        if track then
            return track.name, MusicPlayer.currentTrack
        end
    end
    return "No track", 0
end

-- Toggle shuffle
function MusicPlayer.toggleShuffle()
    MusicPlayer.shuffle = not MusicPlayer.shuffle
    print("Shuffle: " .. (MusicPlayer.shuffle and "ON" or "OFF"))
end

-- Toggle repeat
function MusicPlayer.toggleRepeat()
    MusicPlayer.repeat = not MusicPlayer.repeat
    print("Repeat: " .. (MusicPlayer.repeat and "ON" or "OFF"))
end

-- List all tracks
function MusicPlayer.listTracks()
    print("=== " .. "Empty Collection" .. " ===")
    for i, track in ipairs(MusicPlayer.playlist) do
        local marker = (i == MusicPlayer.currentTrack) and "► " or "  "
        print(marker .. i .. ". " .. track.name)
    end
end

-- Initialize on load
function onLoad()
    print("Empty Collection loaded with " .. #MusicPlayer.playlist .. " tracks")
    print("Use MusicPlayer.play() to start playback")
    print("Use MusicPlayer.listTracks() to see all tracks")
end

-- Export the music player
return MusicPlayer
